# Third-party notices

Data from other projects that is compiled into the curcuma binary, with its license. Code libraries under `external/`
carry their own license files and are not listed here.

## Basis Set Exchange (built-in basis sets of the native QM engine)

**What is derived from it.** `src/core/energy_calculators/qm_methods/qm_basis_tables.h` (GENERATED by
`scripts/qm_basis_export_tables.py`) holds, for the elements H-Ne only:

| Built-in set | BSE source file (repository commit `4adaf1372c7101620ca1a9f3130be9ae97fb8f30`, downloaded 2026-11-01) | How |
|---|---|---|
| def2-SVP | `basis_set_exchange/tests/sources/def2-svp.1.tm.bz2` | unchanged from the BSE download for H-Ne |
| def2-SV(P) | `basis_set_exchange/tests/sources/def2-sv(p).1.tm.bz2` | unchanged from the BSE download for H-Ne |
| def2-universal-JFIT | `basis_set_exchange/tests/sources/def2-universal-jfit.1.tm.bz2` | unchanged from the BSE download for H-Ne |
| def2-universal-JKFIT | `basis_set_exchange/tests/sources/def2-universal-jkfit.1.tm.bz2` | unchanged from the BSE download for H-Ne |
| MINIX (MINIS part) | `basis_set_exchange/data/huzinaga/MINI-scaled.0.json` ('Scaled MINI') | exponents unchanged; coefficients renormalised (below) |

The BSE file headers of the def2 sets state the origin as `Version: 1  (Data from Turbomole 7.3)`; the BSE notes name
Florian Weigend as original contributor (PI F. Weigend, R. Ahlrichs). For MINI-scaled the BSE notes name David Feller
as original contributor (15 Jan 2007). The basis-set files in `src/core/energy_calculators/qm_methods/` stay in the
repository; they take precedence over the built-in copies when found in the basis search path.

**MINIX.** Composition from R. Sure, S. Grimme, J. Comput. Chem. 34, 1672-1685 (2013), Table 1:

| Elements | MINIX |
|---|---|
| H-He, B-Ne | MINIS |
| Li-Be | MINIS + 1(p) |
| Na-Mg | MINIS + 1(p) |
| Al-Ar | MINIS + 1(d) |
| K-Zn | SV |
| Ga-Kr | SVP |
| Rb-Xe | def2-SV(P) with ECP |

Built in: H-Ne only (the engine's element range; Rb-Xe would need ECPs, which the engine does not have). Per element:

| Element | Exponents | Contraction coefficients |
|---|---|---|
| H, He, B-Ne | BSE MINI-scaled | BSE MINI-scaled, each contraction renormalised to a unit-norm contracted function, 10 decimals |
| Li, Be (s shells) | BSE MINI-scaled | as above |
| Li, Be (added p shell: 0.1 / 0.25, coefficient 1) | ORCA 6.1 `orca_exportbasis -b minix` (not in BSE) | ORCA 6.1 |

The renormalised BSE coefficients equal the ORCA 6.1 export and the shipped `MINIX.dat` token for token (raw BSE
coefficients differ from them by up to 1.1e-6 relative, a pure normalisation factor per contraction).

**ORCA 6.1 cross-check** (`orca_exportbasis -b minix|def2-svp|def2-sv(p)|def2/j|def2/jk`, H-Ne, measured 2026-11-01 with
`scripts/qm_basis_export_tables.py --compare-orca`; ORCA prints 10 decimals and renormalises contractions, for the
fitting sets it also sets single-primitive coefficients to 1, so coefficients are compared after normalising both sides):

| Set | exponents, max rel. diff | max abs. diff | coefficients (normalised), max rel. diff | max abs. diff |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| def2-SVP | 5.1e-10 | 5.0e-11 | 1.5e-08 | 8.6e-11 |
| def2-SV(P) | 5.1e-10 | 5.0e-11 | 1.5e-08 | 8.6e-11 |
| def2-universal-JFIT (ORCA def2/J) | 0 | 0 | 3.5e-09 | 5.5e-11 |
| def2-universal-JKFIT (ORCA def2/JK) | 0 | 0 | 1.1e-09 | 5.1e-11 |
| MINIX | 0 | 0 | 0 (raw tokens identical) | 0 |

All differences are at the 1e-10 print resolution of ORCA; shell structure (L, primitives, order) is identical for H-Ne.

R. Ahlrichs, J. Chem. Phys. 97, 2571-2577 (1992). def2-universal-JFIT: F. Weigend, Phys. Chem. Chem. Phys. 8, 1057-1065
